$comment: MCP servers are NOT configured here — Claude Code reads them from ~/.claude.json (via `claude mcp add`) or a root .mcp.json, not from settings.json. The supabase MCP is registered in ~/.claude.json (project scope).

hooks.command: IN=$(cat); rc=0; D="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts"; MISSING=""; for g in verify-tap-guard.mjs verify-test-safety.mjs verify-ui-integrity.mjs verify-audit-coverage.mjs verify-order-retry.mjs; do if [ ! -f "$D/$g" ]; then MISSING="$MISSING $g"; continue; fi; printf '%s' "$IN" | node "$D/$g" --hook || rc=2; done; [ -n "$MISSING" ] && echo "note: guard(s) not in this checkout, so they did NOT run:$MISSING" >&2; exit $rc
hooks.statusMessage: Checking taps, test safety, UI integrity, audit coverage + ordering/offline...
